name: Rohit Sharma
pain: Pipeline bahut unpredictable hai. Ek mahine 5 calls, next month 0. Leads aate hain but mostly unqualified. Demo-to-close 60+ days lag jata hai.
prior_experience: Yes - Tried HubSpot, didn't work for us
outcome: If pipeline becomes predictable, I can scale team confidently and hit ₹25Cr this year.

name: Priya Menon
pain: Client acquisition bahut expensive hai. Ads pe ₹1L+ monthly but ROI nahi dikh raha. Retainer clients nahi ban rahe, sab one-off projects.
outcome: Agar 5 retainer clients aa jaayein predictable, toh hiring kar sakti hoon and agency scale kar sakti hoon.

name: Karthik Iyer
pain: Unqualified trials bahut hain. 100 trials me se 5 hi convert hote. Sales team expensive hai but efficiency low. Demo calls pe bahut time waste.
budget: ₹5L+ - not an issue if ROI clear
prior_experience: Yes - Multiple tools tried, partial success
outcome: If trial-to-paid doubles, we hit Series A targets 6 months early.

name: Anjali Gupta
pain: Launch fatigue hai. Har month webinar karke thak gayi. Evergreen funnel nahi ban raha. Ads costly, organic slow.
prior_experience: Yes - Tried funnels, didn't work well
outcome: Agar evergreen system ban jaye, toh I can focus on delivery instead of selling every month.
